params.message:
Netwerk: name the partners tab after what it shows, and the takers line after the handover

The relation panel's second tab was called 'Werkt samen met', and each row in it
ended with 'neemt over: <colleague>'. Both read as people working together, so it
was unclear whether the names were partners on site or GLK colleagues taking the
relation over. The tab is now 'Samen op projecten', and the row's last line says
'overdracht aan <colleague>' or 'overdracht: nog aan niemand', tying it to the
Overdracht tab next to it.

The tabs size to their label (flex-auto, a little less padding on a phone), so
the longer label still fits beside Overdracht at 390px.
